answer: Role-diversity fingerprinting tends the agent economy like an orchard: each epoch every agent draws one random role — worker, auditor, or gardener — and performs it live. Agents wander between roles, so after six epochs an honest agent holds a varied history, a vine of scored performances. Three random peers audit each one; histories over 90% alike across a group betray one operator behind many masks, and the cluster is quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Faking 1,000 identities needs 6,000 performances per cycle, about 1,000 operators; an honest agent just does one role per epoch, free.
